qualifierLines: {**16 NY3d at 787} OPINION OF THE COURT

By limiting defendant's argument on summation, the trial court impermissibly infringed on defendant's constitutional right to present an argument to the jury which was reasonably supported by the evidence. Further, by misstating the appropriate standard of proof in a portion of the jury charge (see majority mem at 788), the trial court unwittingly fostered a guilty verdict in accordance with the victim's testimony. Because these errors, individually and cumulatively, deprived defendant of a fair trial, I respectfully dissent.
